title: Turn Economy — guerilla notes and proto PRD
body:
Overview:
Quick scratchpad for an experimental feature I keep calling "Turn Economy" — idea: treat conversational turns as first-class charge/quality units so apps can trade fidelity per turn rather than monolithic per-request knobs. This doc is chaotic notes -> proto PRD -> user stories -> experiments.

Problem statement:
- Customers build chat agents that have wildly different value per turn (greeting vs. critical instruction vs. code block). Current levers are coarse (model selection, temperature, max_tokens, route to cheaper model) but not per-turn granular or composable.
- Need a low-friction way to express turn-level fidelity budgets and let platform optimize cost/latency while preserving critical-turn quality.

Goals (MVP):
- Provide a compact declarative API to mark turns with a fidelity intent (e.g., fallback, economical, precise, fallback-if-latency)
- Runtime applies routing/quantization/batching/budgeting heuristics per-turn to meet global budget SLOs
- Expose telemetry (per-turn cost, latency, quality proxy) in Console and tracing

Success metrics (experimental):
- 20% reduction in token spend for mixed-traffic agents with <5% drop in critical-turn eval score
- 95th pct latency within SLA for prioritized turns

Personas:
- Small startup product engineer: wants simple API to reduce bill without manual prompt surgery
- Platform engineer: needs predictable billing and auditability across teams
- App PM: wants guardrails so assistant doesn’t skimp on safety-critical answers

MVP API sketch (very rough):
- conversation.create_turn({ role: 'assistant', content: '...', intent: 'economical' })
- intent options: economical | normal | precise | emergency | checkpoint
- server-side override: route_policies can map intent -> model_variant/quant_profile/qos

User stories (priority rough):
- As a PM, I can label system prompts as "checkpoint" so they always get precise rendering even when budget-saver is on
- As an engineer, I can set a tenant-wide fractional budget (tokens/hour) and platform will autoscale cheaper model routing when hitting threshold
- As SRE, I can see per-turn reroute events and fallbacks in trace view

Acceptance notes / constraints:
- Intent must not leak PII; labels are metadata only and persisted in audit logs with redaction rules
- Backwards compatible: default intent = normal behavior -> existing apps unchanged
- Control plane makes policy decisions but allow per-tenant overrides (enterprise only)

Runtime ideas (brain dump):
- Map intent -> class of actions: (model downgrade, quantize, shorter context, no-codegen kernels, prefetched KV)
- Keep KV cache affinity for "checkpoint/precise" so follow-up turns don’t immediately lose quality
- Soft budget: when budget low, best-effort convert non-critical turns to short-form answers + embedding-only responses for search-style queries

UI/Console work (short):
- New Turn Economics page under Console -> optimize: show heatmap of intents, cost per intent, top callers by cost, sample reroutes
- Quick toggle to enable tenant simulation mode (simulate 30 days of traffic with intents)

Experiment plan (alpha):
- Step 0: internal simulation using existing request traces (sample ~30 tenants). Heuristic mapper that labels turns using heuristics (utterance length, presence of code, user flags) -> estimate savings and QA degradation via offline eval
- Step 1: rollout opt-in alpha to 5 internal teams, collect per-turn telemetry + human eval on 1k critical-turns
- Step 2: tuned policy engine + canary customer with billing opt-in and console insights

Open questions / parking lot:
- How to version intents? (intent taxonomy will evolve)
- Billing model: per-turn premium or per-intent multiplier? Do we surface as a new meter?
- How to handle multimodal turns (image+text) where fidelity needs differ per component?
- Safety regressions — need automatic eval hooks + rollback policies in rollouts

Quick todos (notes-to-self):
- Pull 7 days of chat logs + create automated heuristic labeler (Evan)
- Draft confluence proto page with API examples (Mira)
- Talk to billing about meter options and product/legal implications (Isabel)
- Build minimal console mockups for design review (ask design for 2x mockups)

Random ideas to revisit:
- "Receipt mode": condensed short public-facing recap generated with economical intent while long answer retained on internal KV for audit
- "Intent inference": allow platform to suggest intent based on real-time classifier; surface suggestion but allow app override

Notes end — messy intentionally. Will fold into a cleaner PRD when we have results from simulation run.
note: This document is an informal working draft saved under users/. Expect lots of broken bullets and TODOs. Keep it lightweight — internal brainstorming not final product.
